name: Saori Shishido
source: Whilst disguising herself as her twin brother, Kaname, Saori joins the ranks of the Nagasaki Vigilante to receive aid for her village and exact revenge against the perpetrator of Kaname's death - a wealthy merchant named Saburo Suetsugu.
